notes: Both מֵאֵת pairs are contiguous compound prepositions rendered by a single of, so rule 30's one-rendering condition is met and fusion is correct; each unit already names the split reading as the alternative.

The distributive each on t014 is placed on אָב rather than on the doubled מַטֶּה. This is right for the same reason rule 29 gives a possessive phrase's determiner to the possessor's own word: each stands before fathers in the English possessive expression each fathers house. The unit names the competing reading, satisfying rule 8.

The suffix on שְׁמוֹ is unrepresented under rule 22 because the ASV writes one possessive, every man's, for both it and אִישׁ. Compare NUM.17.9, where the ASV writes every man and his separately and both morphemes are aligned; the two verses are consistent, not divergent.
